name: amigit
description: Git client for AmigaOS 3.x over HTTPS
readme:
Short:        Git client for AmigaOS 3.x over HTTPS
Type:         dev/misc
Architecture: m68k-amigaos >= 68020
Uploader:     duncan@bowring.us
Author:       Duncan Bowring (amiport, built on libgit2)
Version:      0.2
URL:          https://github.com/bdgscotland/amiport

amigit 0.2 -- DEVELOPER PREVIEW

The first git client for AmigaOS 3.x with HTTPS networking.
Clone public repositories from GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg, or
any HTTPS git server.

What works today:
  - amigit clone https://github.com/user/repo [dest]
  - amigit ls-remote https://github.com/user/repo
  - Local repository operations: status, log, show, diff, add,
    commit, branch, checkout, tag
  - Reading existing repos created by another git
  - Authentication via ENV:GIT_HTTP_TOKEN (PAT) or interactive
    raw-mode prompt on HTTP 401

What does NOT work yet:
  - fetch, pull, push (0.3 milestone)
  - SSH, git://, or plain HTTP transports (HTTPS only)
  - amigit init from a multi-character volume name (WORK:,
    Ram Disk:). Workaround: Assign R: WORK: ; amigit init R:foo
  - Clone destination with a multi-character volume name has the
    same limitation. Workaround: use a single-letter Assign
  - Merge, rebase, cherry-pick, revert, stash
  - Color output, pager integration, interactive flows
  - Multi-word commit messages via -m (use -F <file> instead)

Authentication for private repos:
  SetEnv GIT_HTTP_TOKEN ghp_your_pat_here
  SetEnv GIT_HTTP_USERNAME your_username
  amigit clone https://github.com/user/private-repo

  Or omit the env vars and amigit prompts interactively.

Roadmap:
  0.2 (this release) -- HTTPS clone and ls-remote
  0.3 -- fetch and pull (incremental updates)
  1.0 -- push (bidirectional sync, Aminet release)
  Future -- SSH support, merge, rebase, stash

Requirements:
  - AmigaOS 3.x with 68020+ CPU (Vampire, A1200/030+, A3000+)
  - AmiSSL 5.x installed (for HTTPS)
  - TCP/IP stack (Roadshow, Miami, AmiTCP)
  - 4 MB free RAM minimum

Binary: ~1.2 MB (stripped). Stack: 256 KB.

Built on: libgit2 1.8.5, zlib 1.3.1, amiport posix-shim,
          bsdsocket-shim, AmiSSL 5 SDK
Cross-compiled with m68k-amigaos-gcc 6.5.0b.
103/103 FS-UAE functional tests passing.

Bug reports: https://github.com/bdgscotland/amiport/issues

Exit codes:
  0  = success (RETURN_OK)
  10 = error (RETURN_ERROR)
  20 = fatal (RETURN_FAIL)
porting_notes: DEVELOPER PREVIEW (0.2). First git client for AmigaOS 3.x with HTTPS networking. Written from scratch on libgit2 1.8.5 with a custom smart-HTTP subtransport on AmiSSL (PDR-012). 0.2 ships clone and ls-remote over HTTPS. Local commands: status, log, show, diff, add, commit, checkout, branch, tag. Compiled -O1 -m68020 with bundled libgit2-020.a, libz-020.a, libamiport-020.a. Authentication via ENV:GIT_HTTP_TOKEN (Personal Access Token) with interactive raw-mode fallback on 401. Roadmap: 0.3 = fetch + pull, 1.0 = push + Aminet release.
known_limitations: DEVELOPER PREVIEW. (1) Clone requires HTTPS -- no SSH, git://, or plain HTTP. (2) No fetch, pull, or push yet (0.3 milestone). (3) 'amigit init' from a multi-character volume name (WORK:, Ram Disk:) requires an AmigaDOS Assign workaround. Clone has the same limitation for the destination path. (4) No merge, rebase, cherry-pick, revert, or stash. (5) Commit messages via -m must be single shell tokens; use -F <file> for multi-word messages. (6) No color output, no pager integration. (7) Requires AmiSSL for clone/ls-remote. (8) Requires 4 MB free RAM. (9) 68020 minimum -- no plain 68000/A500 support.
